labels.label: mghdprop:EquivCha
labels.reason: The label is the whole proposition: (i) <=> (ii) <=> (iii) and 'at most one corresponding boundary point'. (i) => (ii), the target, is proved in full with no hypothesis beyond the target's uses and the KSide setting. (iii) => (i) is the library's Causal.CBG.corresponds_of_tendsto. (ii) => (iii), which the paper calls trivial (Maximal_GHD2.tex:564), needs a timelike curve of U ending at p: here C.CausallyArcConnected (outside the target's uses) and p regular (p not in Sing; Sing is empty in the paper's smooth setting). The uniqueness clause is proved through it (sbierski_prop_3_7_unique) or, without arc-connectedness, by the library's IsCorrPair.eq_of_corresponds under q, q' in the frontier of V and in J+(psi S). Hence partial and not marked; see questions[0] for the ruling that would make it closed.

findings: Maximal_GHD2.tex:573 and :580: 'q := psi^{-1}(q')' needs q' in psi(U), which the choice 'q' in V' cap I^-(p')' (footnote at :573) does not give; the first claim (:566) only identifies I^-(p') cap psi(U). Repair used here: take q' in I^+(psi(gamma(s_0))) as well, so that causal convexity of psi(U) (with p' in its closure) puts q' in psi(U) (Causality.mem_of_le_of_lt_of_mem_closure); in the paper's setting one may instead shrink V' into J^+ of the Cauchy surface.

Maximal_GHD2.tex:564: '(ii) => (iii) [is] trivial' presupposes a timelike curve of U ending at p. In the smooth setting this holds (a point of I^-(p) in U, joined to p by a timelike curve); it should be said. In ETT it needs causal arc-connectedness and a regular p, and at a BTZ point (i) => (iii) is false: lightlikeLine_sbierski_prop_3_7_iii_fails (the lightlike line, every point singular, p = q = 1 corresponding, no chronal curve at all). This is about ETT's singular extension, not about Sbierski's smooth statement, but it matters for the binder's flat-gx row: there the equivalence holds at regular points only.

Maximal_GHD2.tex:564 (WLOG and its footnote) and :566-571 (the identity psi(I^-(p) cap U) = I^-(p') cap psi(U), the sequence t'_i >> p', the interpolant s): none is needed for (i) => (ii). The proof needs psi(gamma(s)) << p' at the curve's points and one point q' of psi(U) cap I^-(p') near p' with psi^{-1}(q') << p; both time orientations are handled at once, with no side of the Cauchy surface (sbierski_prop_3_7_i_imp_ii), and the curve may be any chronological chain (tendsto_comp_of_chain).
questions: Is causal arc-connectedness of M part of Prop 3.7's setting? The paper defines p << q by future directed timelike curves (Maximal_GHD2.tex:558), whose ETT form is def:causal_arc_connectedness (T-abs-locate-extension carried it the same way, as 'timelike curves realise <<'); but it is not in this target's uses. Reading taken: an added hypothesis (strengthened), so the label is partial and unmarked. If the author rules it carried, sbierski_prop_3_7 (with sbierski_prop_3_7_i_imp_ii and sbierski_prop_3_7_unique, at regular points, Sing empty in the paper) certifies the label in full, and the mark is a one-word docstring change.

Reading of 'timelike curve gamma : (-eps, 0) -> U' (:550): a future or a past chronal curve of the open set U over every closed segment of (-eps, 0) (Causality.TimelikeCurveIn), both orientations as 'timelike' covers both (the convention of Causal.LocateExtension).

Reading of the point q' in V' cap I^-(p') (:573 footnote): it is the strongly tarentin property of p' in the past (Z-, def:strongly_tarentin_point), supplied by KSide.mem_Zminus or by causal arc-connectedness of N. Whether (i) => (ii) holds with the ladder node tarentin (def:tarentin_spacetime) in place of Z- at p' is not settled here (open).

kb_proposals: Sbierski Prop 3.7 (i) => (ii) is ETT-layer and A3-free (CausalScaffold.SbierskiProp37): Causal.CBG.sbierski_prop_3_7_i_imp_ii (KSide form, both time orientations, no side of a Cauchy surface) and _ladder (push-up, GH, tarentin, N causally arc-connected); the core IsCorrPair.tendsto_comp_of_chain works for chronological chains. A smooth-vacuum discharge of A3 following Sbierski may use them (T-abs-sbierski-prop-3-7).

Z- at a point from causal arc-connectedness: CausallyArcConnected.mem_Zminus_iff (Causal.LocateExtension) turns I-(q) nonempty into q in Z-; it replaces KSide.mem_Zminus when only strongly tarentin points are needed (T-abs-sbierski-prop-3-7).

A point of I-(q) above a point of a causally convex V, with q in closure V, lies in V with no countability (Causality.mem_of_le_of_lt_of_mem_closure); the library's Kminus_inter_Jplus_subset_of_causallyConvexIn asks first countability (T-abs-sbierski-prop-3-7).

No timelike curve ends at a BTZ point (I- empty), so Sbierski Prop 3.7 (i) <=> (iii) fails at BTZ points in ETT: lightlikeLine_sbierski_prop_3_7_iii_fails; the equivalence holds at regular points under causal arc-connectedness (sbierski_prop_3_7) (T-abs-sbierski-prop-3-7).
